changes.comment: Pre-flight credential validation (#1316): the demand-driven authenticate chokepoint now fails a spawn fast with a typed FailedPrecondition error when a runtime's enabled credential is missing, or its OAuth login (Claude subscription / Codex) is expired with no refresh token, instead of surfacing an opaque 401 deep inside the runtime. Behavior change: authenticateForRuntime is no longer best-effort never-throws.
